title: Associated graded of a regular-sequence ideal is polynomial
statement:
Let $R$ be a commutative ring, let $c\in\mathbb N$, and let $f_1,\ldots,f_c$ be an $R$-regular sequence [def-weil-pbc-regular-sequence]. Put $J=(f_1,\ldots,f_c)$, $B=R/J$ [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient], and give
$$\operatorname{gr}_J(R)=\bigoplus_{n\geq0}J^n/J^{n+1}$$
the graded $B$-algebra structure of [def-weil-pbc-associated-graded-ring]. Give $B[T_1,\ldots,T_c]$ [def-weil-pbc-mv-polynomial-ring] its total-degree grading. The $B$-algebra homomorphism
$$\theta:B[T_1,\ldots,T_c]\longrightarrow\operatorname{gr}_J(R),\qquad T_j\longmapsto[f_j]_1,$$
which is the identity on $B$ in degree zero, is an isomorphism of graded algebras. In degree $n$ its formula is
$$\theta\left(\sum_{|\alpha|=n}\bar a_\alpha T^\alpha\right)=\left[\sum_{|\alpha|=n}a_\alpha f_1^{\alpha_1}\cdots f_c^{\alpha_c}\right]_n.$$
In particular the degree-$n$ monomials in the $f_j$ form a $B$-basis [def-weil-pbc-free-module] of $J^n/J^{n+1}$ for every $n\geq0$.

proof.text: For a homogeneous relation with value in J^(n+1), expand this value using J*J^n and homogeneous polynomial representatives of J^n. The resulting homogeneous polynomial has all coefficients in J. Subtract it, apply the zero-relation result, and add its coefficients back.

source.place: Tag 00LN (lemma-regular-quasi-regular), part (1), with Tag 061P (definition-quasi-regular-sequence) and Tag 061N (equation-quasi-regular): the canonical polynomial-to-associated-graded map is an isomorphism for a regular sequence.

proof.text: Lift quotient coefficients and take the degree-n component to obtain a homogeneous lift. The evaluation formula and the relation result prove injectivity on each degree. Evaluation commutes with homogeneous projections, by the monomial calculation. Apply this to all components to get injectivity on the full polynomial ring. Homogeneous polynomial representatives of ideal powers give surjectivity on pieces, and direct-sum induction gives surjectivity globally.

proof.text: Projection compatibility and injectivity identify homogeneous polynomials exactly with single-degree images. Restrict the polynomial coefficient finsupp to degree-n indices to obtain a monomial expansion, and read coefficients to prove its uniqueness. Transport this expansion through the bijective map to obtain the stated basis clause.

lean.statement: theorem regularSequence_gradedPolynomial {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {c : ℕ} (f : Fin c → R) (hf : RingTheory.Sequence.IsRegular R (List.ofFn f)) : Function.Bijective (regularSequenceGradedPolynomialMap f) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (p : MvPolynomial (Fin c) (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))), p.IsHomogeneous n ↔ ∃ x : associatedGradedPiece (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) n, regularSequenceGradedPolynomialMap f p = DirectSum.of (associatedGradedPiece (Ideal.span (Set.range f))) n x) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (a : {α : Fin c →₀ ℕ // α.sum (fun _ k ↦ k) = n} →₀ R), ∃ x : (Ideal.span (Set.range f) ^ n : Ideal R), x.val = a.sum (fun α r ↦ r * α.val.prod (fun j k ↦ f j ^ k)) ∧ regularSequenceGradedPolynomialMap f (a.sum (fun α r ↦ MvPolynomial.monomial α.val (Ideal.Quotient.mk (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) r))) = DirectSum.of (associatedGradedPiece (Ideal.span (Set.range f))) n (Submodule.Quotient.mk x)) ∧ (∀ (n : ℕ) (x : associatedGradedPiece (Ideal.span (Set.range f)) n), ∃! a : {α : Fin c →₀ ℕ // α.sum (fun _ k ↦ k) = n} →₀ (R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)), a.sum (fun α b ↦ b • regularSequenceGradedPolynomialMap f (MvPolynomial.monomial α.val 1)) = DirectSum.of (associatedGradedPiece (Ideal.span (Set.range f))) n x)
